purpose: Computes the Voigt–Reuss–Hill (VRH) average shear modulus as the arithmetic mean of the Voigt and Reuss shear moduli.

symbols.meaning: Voigt shear modulus (upper bound), defined in Eq. (5)
Reuss shear modulus (lower bound), defined in Eq. (6)

unmapped: The coefficient 1/2 indicates an arithmetic average of the Voigt and Reuss bounds.
G_V is given by Eq. (5) and G_R by Eq. (6) in the surrounding context.
